# BenzWell — Digital Products Store
> Official public guide and LLM discoverability context for BenzWell.

## Overview
BenzWell is a modern digital products and resources marketplace providing premium developer blueprints, AI prompt packs, masterclasses, and digital tools designed to accelerate creators and engineers.

- **Official Website:** https://benzwell.in
- **Official Contact Email:** info@benzwell.in
- **Admin Alert Email:** ceo.office.atharva@gmail.com
- **Currency:** INR (₹)
- **Payment Gateway:** Razorpay (Secured 256-bit encryption, UPI, Cards, NetBanking)
- **Fulfillment:** Instant digital delivery with 5-minute temporary access tokens and lifetime dashboard access under customer accounts.

## Core Features & Offerings
1. **Developer Workflows & Blueprints:** Production-ready architectures, templates, and full-stack modules.
2. **AI & Prompt Engineering:** Curated prompt libraries, AI agent recipes, and system prompts.
3. **Masterclasses & Ebooks:** High-value digital guides for professionals.
4. **Secure Digital Entitlements:** Cryptographically authorized file downloads directly from private cloud storage.
5. **Verified Customer Reviews:** Authentic review system where only customers who own the product can review.
6. **Support AI & Help Center:** Instant multi-model AI assistant with human support escalation.

## Store Policies
- **Account Requirement:** Mandatory account creation or login before purchase to safeguard digital product entitlements.
- **Refund Policy:** Digital goods delivered instantly are generally non-refundable, except in cases of verified defective files or duplicate charges.
- **Privacy & Security:** Full customer data isolation with row-level security (RLS) and encrypted payment verifications.
